name: avista-activecollab
description: Run the whole task loop in Avista's self-hosted ActiveCollab from Claude Code. Create a task in the shape the work calls for — a runnable prompt in the description for work that has not started, or a short past-tense summary for work already done that just needs somewhere to hang a time record — pull that prompt back out as a working brief, measure the hours from the git log when it lands, book them against the same task, and read them back to check that logged hours actually match the work. Includes a one-time token bootstrap that exchanges the 1Password-held login for an API token without ever storing the password, a pagination-aware `ac` API client, approval-gated write skills that resolve projects, people and job types from names to IDs before posting, and a read-only time audit that routes around the time endpoints which silently ignore the filters they are given.
